notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard partial negotiated attribute-divestiture cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies cancellation of one pending acquisition, confirmation and transfer of only the retained attribute, standard tags and callbacks, ownership state, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, confirmDivestiture, cancelNegotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, ownership-query, and resignation services with standard ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
